tradeoffs.F01: Retain: primary accuracy leader, mean IoU 0.679529, 1.914 s/image, small-region recall 0.189664. Local uncertainty recovers some whole compartments, but native BCSS74 and BCSS87 still miss or misidentify small anatomy. Accuracy is unchanged from cycle three, with exact native parity; no new accuracy gain claimed.
tradeoffs.C17: Retain: compact converged palette model, mean IoU 0.671604 at 0.181 s/image, around one tenth of F01 elapsed time in this run. Small recall 0.183608 is lower. Provides the fast high-overlap branch; broad boundaries can remain displaced and tiny regions lost.
tradeoffs.C01: Retain: tile-plurality observation model, mean IoU 0.663706 at 0.0874 s/image and small recall 0.203302, with 4239 completely missed small regions. G08 gives only 0.000631 higher recall, lower IoU and longer time. Original optimizer has 67 unsuccessful flags and is retained as a finite-budget baseline, not a converged solution.
tradeoffs.D08: Retain: fastest candidate, mean IoU 0.656050 at 0.05045 s/image with small recall 0.194626. Its analytic within-tile nuisance model provides a distinct speed branch; lower accuracy and false internal regions remain. G10 does not improve aggregate accuracy, speed or mean small recall.
tradeoffs.C15: Retain only as the sensitivity research branch: highest mean small-region recall 0.225562, mean IoU 0.644943 at 0.32194 s/image, 4233 completely missed components. Actual views show false rings, merged objects and specks. It is not the recommended default; its three children trade away this recall and do not exceed existing accuracy branches.
tradeoffs.G01: Reject: independent Beta moments give mean IoU 0.674400 versus F01 0.679529 and take 2.106 versus 1.914 s/image. Wins 47, loses 101, ties one. Small recall rises to 0.201831 but C01 is slightly more sensitive and much faster. Native BCSS74 confirms replacement of a true purple core by false grey; strongest-gain BCSS87 still fails its reference central object. G01 is not Pareto-dominated across all three metrics; choosing the five existing branches is a portfolio decision.
tradeoffs.G02: Reject: robust spatial Laplace regression succeeds numerically on all 1515 fits but IoU falls to 0.650768. Small recall 0.206899 costs 0.3508 s/image and produces false rims, including TIGER27 and BCSS fields. It neither replaces the accuracy branch nor C15 sensitivity or D08 speed.
tradeoffs.G03: Reject: disk-clearance reconstruction opens a real reference-zero BCSS18 cleft but misses the BCSS07 gap. It also deletes reference-positive lumina/adipose in TIGER11/25/28 and other cases. IoU falls from F01 0.679529 to 0.667416, with 5726334 additional positive pixels unassigned. True glass and annotated bright anatomy are not resolved by this rule.
tradeoffs.G04: Reject: Poisson palette divergence gives IoU 0.667263 versus C17 0.671604, at 0.2729 versus 0.1812 s/image; small recall improves only from 0.183608 to 0.184380. Broad masks usually resemble the parent and do not justify the cost; residuals after the finite 120-step budget are reported.
tradeoffs.G05: Reject: exact coarse-area mass projection reaches its tolerance on all149 images but IoU drops to 0.654302 and time rises to 1.1198 s/image. Some false islands shrink, but actual views also show deletion of rare compartments and major interior changes. Coarse winner areas are not reliable true class proportions.
tradeoffs.G06: Reject: channel-order model discards useful amplitude and introduces whole-class changes and false gold halos, notably TIGER01/23/32/35 and BCSS examples. IoU 0.617193 and small recall 0.169620 are poor, with 43 cases reaching the finite iteration budget. Clean ordinal mathematics did not yield faithful anatomy.
tradeoffs.G07: Reject: intrabag effective-sample-size correction lowers IoU from C01 0.663706 to 0.658764, slightly lowers small recall and is slightly slower. All optimizer flags succeed but false rims and compartment shifts remain. Better optimizer termination is not a tissue-quality improvement.
tradeoffs.G08: Reject: exact pair-count kernel gives IoU 0.662841 versus C01 0.663706, time 0.13056 versus 0.08741 s/image, and small recall 0.203932 versus 0.203302. Fifteen optimizer flags are unsuccessful and ten more small components are completely missed. C++ kernel/thread evidence is useful, but this marginal recall change does not earn a survivor slot; pair-event product remains a composite likelihood.
tradeoffs.G09: Reject: analytic between-tile ranking is fast at 0.05129 s/image but IoU 0.647922 and small recall 0.188886 are below D08, which is also slightly faster. Actual BCSS52/62 views show major interior class changes. Ranking contrasts do not provide calibrated semantic probabilities.
tradeoffs.G10: Reject: Tyler angular nuisance scatter converges in all cases but IoU 0.655787, time 0.05436 s/image and small recall 0.193804 all trail D08. It reduces the absolute completely-missed count by16 but does not yield a persuasive distinct visual benefit. No aggregate improvement is claimed.
tradeoffs.G11: Reject: pooled rank geometry gives many false islands, merged objects and grey/purple mottling, including TIGER08/17/23/31/39. IoU falls to 0.622837 and small recall 0.220679 is still below C15. Faster execution does not compensate for broad semantic failures.
tradeoffs.G12: Reject: matched adjacent-tile contrasts give small recall 0.204656 at 0.05499 s/image but IoU drops to 0.650984. BCSS examples have interior class changes; TIGER masks mostly resemble D08. Keep D08 speed and C01/C15 sensitivity branches instead of this compromise.
tradeoffs.G13: Reject: sliced patch transport improves IoU over C15 to 0.648958 but costs 1.2002 s/image and reduces small recall to 0.181096, with 4594 completely missed components. Actual views show smoothing/coalescence of small red branches and expansion of some grey regions. The distributional patch observation does not add a useful branch.
tradeoffs.G14: Reject: colour-mode basins run quickly at 0.05676 s/image and improve C15 IoU slightly to 0.646508, but small recall falls to 0.171091. Actual views show whole-interior relabelling and loss of rare purple/red classes. Unsupported modes remain unknown identity; density modes cannot safely name a new tissue class.
tradeoffs.G15: Reject: joint maximum-entropy density improves C15 IoU to 0.652515, but lowers small recall to 0.187579 at 0.35893 s/image. D08 is faster with higher mean IoU and small recall. All505 fits report success, but false rims and rare-region loss remain; numerical fitting success does not validate anatomy.
